name: Engaged mechanical coupling
summary: This indication identifies engagement between the represented mechanical elements.
description: This indication identifies engagement between the represented mechanical elements. The represented elements share the documented motion-transmission relationship in the engaged state. That state says nothing by itself about supply energisation or electrical contact position.
Show the driving/driven device identities and connect the engagement state to its actual feedback if used. Alternate publisher graphical forms are retained within this one concept.
readingNotes: Document the elements coupled and the applicable state condition.
Different published graphical forms for the same engagement are kept in one concept record.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Document the elements coupled and the applicable state condition.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: Different published graphical forms for the same engagement are kept in one concept record.
